_comment: Automated, non-gating shared-CI evidence for examples/pricing-api. #99 adds two scenarios: the distinct-account and mixed-assured p50 ratios are null until calibrated on the controlled host, and null reports as disabled rather than as passing. The shed thresholds are comparative and set in both manifests: best-effort work must be shed several times more often than assured work under a reserve, that advantage must vanish under a class-blind uniform pool of the same size, and a run that sheds no best-effort work has not saturated and has proved nothing. Workload and ratio ceilings intentionally match load_thresholds.json. Absolute p50/p99 ceilings and throughput floors are explicitly disabled because shared-runner performance is not calibrated; evidence mode records ratio misses without failing the job, while null values are reported as disabled rather than treated as passing measurements.
